A high score is NOT a buy-now; the green dot means the entry is open today.在周线·3日·日线上完全共振（筑底，而非接飞刀）· 每张卡片两个量表：持有信念分（领先·质量·估值）+ 独立的入场量表 — 立即买入，或等待回撤至某价位。高分并不等于立即买入；绿点代表今日入场窗口已开。 ?Each name carries TWO independent gauges so a great company is never confused with a great entry. (1) OWN-IT CONVICTION (the 0-100 score): leadership (validated sector-neutral residual momentum α across the S&P 1500) + quality + a forward-aware valuation read — a cheap-on-forward leader like NVDA is NOT penalized for a rich trailing multiple. It surfaces leaders that aren't in any sector ETF's top-10. It is a within-market percentile DISPLAY skin (not a probability) and reads 'high-confluence (context)' until a deep Phase-0 proves forward edge; the α leg is just one light, regime-scaled input, not the rank key. (2) ENTRY TIMING (the coloured strip): the price-cycle read across daily/3-day/weekly — buy now (green dot), wait for the pullback to the shown buy-zone price, or extended/topping (don't chase). Two VERIFIERS — an Options (dealer-gamma) check and a single-stock volatility-squeeze read — sharpen the ENTRY only (display + a small bounded tilt); they can lower conviction but never manufacture a buy, and never touch the selection rank. The price-cycle state is a HARD modifier: a name late in its cycle, in a downtrend or topping, can NEVER read 'buy now' — it reads 'strong name, wrong tape', which is why this card and the stock's own page never disagree. The board is sorted by conviction; the entry gauge tells you which are actionable today. Click any card for the full breakdown.每个标的带有两个相互独立的量表，使“好公司”绝不等同于“好入场点”。(1) 持有信念（0-100 分）：领先度（在标普1500内已验证的行业中性残差动量 α）+ 质量 + 前瞻估值读数——像 NVDA 这种前瞻便宜的领涨股不会因偏高的历史倍数而被扣分。它能发掘不在任何行业ETF前十大持仓中的领涨股。它是市场内百分位的展示皮肤（非概率），在深度 Phase-0 证明前瞻优势前显示为“高共振（参考）”；α 维度只是一个轻量、随行情缩放的输入，并非排序关键。(2) 入场择时（彩色条）：跨日线/3日/周线的价格周期读数——立即买入（绿点）、等待回撤至所示买入区价位，或过度拉伸/做顶（勿追高）。两个验证器——期权（做市商 Gamma）检查与个股波动压缩读数——只优化“入场”（展示＋小幅有界倾斜）；它们可降低确信度，但绝不制造买入信号，也不触及选股排序。价格周期状态是硬性修正项：处于周期晚期、下行或做顶的个股永远不会显示“立即买入”，而显示“强势但趋势不利”，因此本卡片与个股自身页面绝不冲突。榜单按信念排序；入场量表告诉你今天哪些可操作。点击任意卡片查看完整拆解。

Market breadth — how many stocks are actually participating市场广度 — 究竟有多少股票在参与 ?Breadth across the full S&P Composite 1500 (large = S&P 500, mid = S&P 400, small = S&P 600): how many stocks are advancing, how many hold above their 50- and 200-day lines, and net new 52-week highs. A strong index riding on a shrinking number of stocks is fragile — broad participation confirms a move, thinning breadth is an early warning. The % above the 50-day line also feeds the regime model's growth axis, so this is the same breadth the model reads, just made legible.覆盖整个标普综合 1500（大盘 = 标普500、中盘 = 标普400、小盘 = 标普600）的广度：多少股票上涨、多少守在其 50 日与 200 日均线之上，以及净创 52 周新高。指数走强却只靠越来越少的股票支撑则脆弱 — 广泛参与确认走势，广度变薄是早期预警。高于 50 日线的占比也进入周期模型的增长轴，因此这与模型读取的是同一广度，只是更直观。

Advanced breadth — the market internals under the tape高级广度 — 盘面之下的市场内部结构 ?The classic 'market internals' a desk watches beyond today's %-above-MA snapshot: the McClellan Oscillator & Summation Index (breadth momentum), the Zweig Breadth Thrust gauge, the High-Low Index, whether the advance/decline line confirms price, and where participation sits in its own multi-decade history. Computed on the DEEP S&P 500 breadth series (1962-). These are SECOND-DERIVATIVE reads of the same breadth — they describe the QUALITY of the move (broad vs narrow, accelerating vs rolling over). Display-only: breadth internals are a function of price, so they're coincident with it by construction — this explains the tape, it does not forecast it. Survivorship caveat: the deep series is rebuilt from today's members, so the percentile context is taken over the mature-universe window only.盘面之下、超越「高于均线占比」快照的经典「市场内部结构」：麦克莱伦振荡指标与累积指标（广度动量）、兹威格广度脉冲、新高—新低指数、腾落线是否确认价格，以及当前参与度在其数十年历史中的分位。基于标普500深度广度序列（1962年起）计算。这些是同一广度的二阶读数 — 描述走势的「质量」（广泛或狭窄、加速或回落）。仅作展示：内部结构是价格的函数、与价格同步，用于解释盘面而非预测。幸存者偏差提示：深度序列以当前成分股重建，故分位背景仅取成熟样本区间。

McClellan Oscillator麦克莱伦振荡指标 ?Ratio-adjusted McClellan Oscillator: the 19-day minus 39-day EMA of net advances (normalised so a changing universe size doesn't distort it). Above zero & rising = breadth momentum building; below zero & falling = internals rolling over. The Summation Index is its running total — its slope and sign carry the meaning, not the absolute (cumulative) level.比率调整后的麦克莱伦振荡指标：净上涨家数的19日与39日指数均线之差（已归一化，避免样本规模变化造成失真）。高于零且上行 = 广度动量在累积；低于零且下行 = 内部结构在回落。累积指标是其累计和 — 关键在斜率与正负号，而非绝对（累计）水平。

Breadth Thrust (Zweig)广度脉冲（兹威格） ?The 10-day EMA of the advancers' share, advances / (advances + declines). Zweig's classic launch signal fires when it surges from below 0.40 (washed out) through 0.615 (thrust) inside 10 days — a rare, powerful 'everything's going up at once' kick-off. HONESTY: on our survivorship-biased S&P-500 proxy the strict crossing fires far more often than the canonical ~once-a-decade NYSE signal (rebuilt-from-survivors rebounds look broader than they were live), so read this as a momentum gauge, not the rare historic trigger.上涨家数占比（上涨 /(上涨+下跌)）的10日指数均线。兹威格的经典启动信号：在10日内自0.40以下（超卖）急升突破0.615（脉冲）时触发 —— 罕见而强劲的「同涨」启动。诚实说明：在带有幸存者偏差的标普500代理上，严格的穿越远比经典的纽交所「十年一遇」信号更频繁（以幸存者重建的反弹看起来比当时更广），故此处作为动量计读取，而非罕见的历史触发。

High-Low Index新高—新低指数 ?The 10-day average of the record-high percent: 52-week new highs as a share of (new highs + new lows). Above 50 = new highs are outpacing new lows (an expanding, healthy new-high ledger); below 50 = the new-low side is winning (deterioration). A/D line vs price腾落线对价格 ?Does the cumulative advance/decline line confirm the index's recent extremes? If price prints a fresh 3-month high the A/D line will NOT confirm, the advance is narrowing underneath (bearish divergence); a fresh price low the A/D line refuses to confirm is a bullish divergence. Otherwise the internals are confirming the move, or nothing is at an extreme (in range). The sparkline traces the A/D line; the correlation is price-vs-A/D over the last 60 sessions.累积腾落线是否确认指数近期的极值？若价格创3个月新高而腾落线未确认，则上涨在底层收窄（看跌背离）；若价格创新低而腾落线拒绝确认，则为看涨背离。否则即为内部结构确认走势，或均未触及极值（区间内）。曲线描绘腾落线；相关系数为近60个交易日价格与腾落线的相关性。

Participation in context参与度的历史背景 ?Today's % of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day line, set against its own deep history: the percentile tells you where this reading ranks vs every day since the universe matured, and the 20-day change is the momentum of participation (is it broadening or thinning?). Sector Bottom Radar — washout durability, not rotation板块见底雷达 — 错杀的持久性，而非轮动 ?The buy-side complement to the heat board below. It runs the SAME validated 'Bottom Confidence' score we compute per stock (walk-forward calibrated monotone on 69k evals) on each sector ETF: how DURABLE a washing-out sector's low looks — high = the kind of selloff whose low has historically held with a SHALLOWER drawdown — discounted when the turn isn't confirmed on the weekly/monthly and when price is a deep falling-knife below its 200-day. The whole board is then conditioned by the index Fed-put gate: in a put-absent regime (recession or inflation-locked Fed) the same washout signals kept falling in 2000/2008/2022. This is a RISK / DURABILITY read, NOT a return forecast and NOT alpha — it trades some of the explosive bounce for a much higher chance the low holds. The heat board describes what's already hot (and late); this finds where a durable low may be forming. Validated in research/SECTOR_BOTTOM_RADAR.md.下方热度榜的买方补充。它在每个板块 ETF 上运行与个股相同的、经验证的「见底信心」分数（经 6.9 万次步进式校准、单调有效）：衡量一个正被错杀的板块其低点有多持久——分数越高，代表这类抛售的低点历史上更易守住、回撤更浅——当周线／月线尚未确认转向、或价格深跌破 200 日线（接飞刀）时会打折。整个看板再由指数层面的美联储托底闸门来条件化：在托底缺位（衰退或通胀锁死）的格局下，同类超卖信号在 2000／2008／2022 年持续下跌。这是风险／持久性读数，并非收益预测、也非超额收益——它以让出部分爆发式反弹，换取低点守住的更高概率。热度榜描述的是已经火热（且偏晚）的板块；本雷达则寻找可能正在形成的持久低点。验证见 research/SECTOR_BOTTOM_RADAR.md。

Macro gate宏观闸门: Index Fed-put is INTACT — buyable-washout regime. Sector lows that score well are favoured to hold with a shallower drawdown; confirm into stabilization, don't anticipate.指数层面美联储托底仍在——可买入错杀格局。评分较高的板块低点更倾向于守住且回撤更浅；确认企稳后再介入，勿抢跑。

sector板块 bottom confidence见底信心 ? Bottom Confidence 0-100 — how durable, low-drawdown this sector's low looks. Measured (sector ETFs, 1998-2026): sectors scoring 60+ held their cycle low ~79% of the time vs ~34% at 0-20, with a shallower drawdown tail. Higher = a more durable low, not a bigger bounce (the deepest washouts bounce hardest but rarely hold). Risk/durability, never a return forecast. 见底信心 0-100 — 衡量该板块的低点有多持久、回撤有多浅。实测（板块 ETF，1998-2026）：得分 60+ 的板块约 79% 守住其周期低点，而 0-20 区间仅约 34%，且回撤尾部更浅。分数越高代表低点越持久，而非反弹更大（最深的错杀反弹最猛，却很少守住）。这是风险／持久性，绝非收益预测。 verdict判定 members washed / turning成分股超卖／转向 ?Live breadth confirmer: of the sector's S&P 500 members, the share below their 200-day (washed out) and, of those, the share reclaiming their 10-day (turning up). Displayed context only — the breadth cache is ~1y deep so this leg is not deep-backtested and never enters the score.实时宽度确认：在该板块的标普500成分股中，跌破 200 日线（超卖）的比例，以及其中已收复 10 日线（转向）的比例。仅作背景参考——宽度缓存约 1 年深度，该项未经深度回测，且不计入分数。 read解读

Sector buy/sell setups — 3-day MACD + StochRSI confluence板块买卖配置 — 3 日 MACD + StochRSI 共振 ? The primary sector timing engine: a confluence of MACD + StochRSI crossovers on the 3-day chart (the daily is the early trigger), gated by the 200-day trend and sorted most-actionable first. Validated 1998-2026 (research/SECTOR_CONFLUENCE.md) — the base-rate column is the MEASURED forward-63-day excess vs SPY for each state:
stateread it asfwd 63d vs SPY*
BUYfresh up-turn on daily + 3-day, above trend+0.9% (56% up)
SETUPapproaching an up-cross — get ready+0.3..0.7%
EXTENDEDoverbought, late — hold/trim, don't chase~flat
TOPPINGoverbought + rolling over — distribution−0.1%
SELLoverbought + confirmed 3-day down-cross−1.2% (40% up)
BELOW TRENDunder the 200-day — knife; wait for a reclaim−0.1%
OVERSOLD BOUNCErange-bound defensive (XLU/XLP/XLV/XLRE), oversold dip below trend, Fed-put on — tactical bounce, lags SPY+4.0% abs / +0.3% vs SPY
*measured per state across the 11 sector ETFs. The OVERSOLD BOUNCE row's headline is its ABSOLUTE return (the dip bounces); its vs-SPY is shown beside it because a low-beta defensive tends to lag a rising index — a tactical mean-reversion trade, never a confirmed buy. Honest ceiling: hit-rates ~50-56% — the edge is in magnitude and in AVOIDANCE (it stops you chasing the "confirmed leadership" that institutions distribute into), not a high win-rate. A risk/timing map, not a return forecast. 板块择时主引擎：3 日图上 MACD + StochRSI 交叉的共振（日线作为早期触发），以 200 日趋势把关， 按可操作性排序。已用 1998–2026 验证（research/SECTOR_CONFLUENCE.md）——基础概率列为各状态 实测的未来 63 日对 SPY 超额：
状态解读未来63日对SPY*
买入日线+3日线同时转上，且在趋势之上+0.9%（56%上涨）
预备接近上穿——准备+0.3..0.7%
过热超买、已晚——持有/减仓，勿追≈持平
见顶超买+回落——派发−0.1%
卖出超买+3日线确认下穿−1.2%（40%上涨）
趋势下方200日线下方——接飞刀；等待收复−0.1%
超卖反弹区间震荡的防御板块（XLU/XLP/XLV/XLRE），趋势下方超卖回调、美联储托底在位——战术反弹，跑输SPY+4.0% 绝对 / +0.3% 对SPY
*按状态、跨 11 个板块 ETF 实测。「超卖反弹」一行的主数字是其绝对回报（回调会反弹）；旁边的对SPY数字 说明低贝塔防御板块在上涨指数中通常跑输——属战术性均值回归交易，绝非确认买入。诚实上限：胜率约 50–56%——优势在于幅度与「回避」（避免追逐机构 派发的「已确认领先」），而非高胜率。这是风险/择时地图，不是收益预测。

3 on the buy side在买入侧 · 6 extended / topping / below trend过热／见顶／趋势下方. Cross-sectionally the buy side has beaten the avoid side by ~0.8%/quarter (1998-2026). Use it to time rotation and to NOT chase extended leaders — never as a return forecast.横截面上买入侧每季度约跑赢回避侧 0.8%（1998–2026）。用于把握轮动、避免追逐过热领先股——切勿当作收益预测。

sector板块 verdict判断 ?BUY/SETUP = an entry above the 200-day; EXTENDED/TOPPING/SELL = late or distributing; BELOW TREND = a knife. Dots = conviction (how many of daily / 3-day MACD / 3-day StochRSI agree).买入/预备＝200日线上方的入场；过热/见顶/卖出＝偏晚或派发中；趋势下方＝接飞刀。圆点＝信心（日线／3日 MACD／3日 StochRSI 中有几个一致）。 3-day signal3 日信号 ?What actually fired on the 3-day chart (the daily is the early trigger): a MACD/StochRSI crossover, a curl approaching a cross (with an ETA in trading days), or a roll-over.3 日图上实际触发了什么（日线为早期触发）：MACD/StochRSI 交叉、接近交叉的拐头（含预计交易日数）、或回落。 trend趋势 ?Price vs its 200-day (long-term) and 50-day (medium-term) average — the gate that separates a buyable pullback from a falling knife.价格相对 200 日（长期）与 50 日（中期）均线——把可买回调与接飞刀分开的闸门。 RSI / Stoch (3D)RSI / Stoch（3 日） ?The 3-day RSI(14) and StochRSI. Above 70 / 80 = extended (late). StochRSI crossing up over 20 from oversold is the bottoming tell; dropping out of 80 is the topping tell.3 日 RSI(14) 与 StochRSI。高于 70／80＝过热（偏晚）。StochRSI 从超卖上穿 20 是见底信号；跌出 80 是见顶信号。 3mo vs mkt3 月对比市场 ?Relative strength vs the S&P 500 over the past ~60 trading days.过去约 60 个交易日相对标普 500 的强弱。 seasonality季节性 ?This sector's average return in the current calendar month. Hover for the full 12-month picture. Weak evidence — context only, never a signal on its own.该板块在当前日历月的平均回报。悬停查看完整 12 个月全貌。弱证据——仅作背景参考，绝不单独作为信号。 base rate基础概率 ?The MEASURED forward 63-day excess vs SPY for this state across the 11 sector ETFs 1998-2026 — the signal's honest track record, not a promise.该状态实测的未来 63 日对 SPY 超额，跨 11 个板块 ETF、1998–2026——信号的真实历史记录，并非承诺。

🐳 Accumulation watch — sector ETFs🐳 增持监测 — 板块 ETF ?Each sector SPDR's top-10 weights, with each holding's weight change split into the part explained by the stock's own price move and a residual ('active' = weight that grew MORE than price alone). A large positive residual = real buying flowed into the name beyond market drift. HONEST CAVEAT: these SPDRs are PASSIVE index funds, so the residual is index reconstitution / float-weight flow (forced index-fund buying), NOT a discretionary manager's conviction — that reading comes with the active funds in the planned top-200 page. The technical column shows the stock's own cycle state; ✅ marks accumulation that also has a forming buy setup. Thresholds are uncalibrated until more snapshot history accumulates.每只板块 SPDR 的前十大权重；每只持仓的权重变动被拆分为“由个股自身价格变动解释的部分”与“残差”（“主动”=权重增长超过价格涨幅的部分）。较大的正残差=除市场漂移外确有真实买盘流入该股。诚实提示：这些 SPDR 是被动指数基金，故残差代表指数再平衡／流通权重调整带来的资金流（被动强制买入），并非主动经理的信念——后者要等到计划中的前 200 ETF 页面里的主动基金。技术面列显示个股自身的周期状态；✅ 表示增持同时出现了正在形成的买入形态。在积累更多快照历史前，阈值尚未校准。

Building — needs at least two daily holdings snapshots per fund (collection began 2026-06-11). Decomposed accumulation signals appear once a second snapshot lands.构建中 — 每只基金至少需要两个每日持仓快照（采集自 2026-06-11 开始）。第二个快照落地后将显示拆解后的增持信号。

Real fund moves — strongest conviction基金真实动作 — 信念最强 ?The top conviction-ranked ACCUMULATION decisions across curated thematic/industry funds (SPDR sector, Global X) and actively managed funds (ARK), with mechanical flow AND price moves stripped out. Conviction = percentage POINTS of fund weight the manager actually committed — so a real add to a meaningful position outranks a tiny position doubling. The full board (incl. trims & every fund) is the 🐳 Real fund moves page.在精选的主题／行业基金（SPDR 板块、Global X）与主动管理基金（ARK）中，按信念排序的最强增持决策，已剔除机械性资金流与价格变动。信念 = 经理人实际投入的基金权重百分点——因此对有意义仓位的真实增持会胜过微小仓位的翻倍。完整看板（含减持与全部基金）见 🐳 基金真实动作 页面。 see all →查看全部 →
